fact: Redux Maker v1 routes kill-effect proposals to timecycle_mods_4.xml (timecycle 4), not animpostfx.ymt.
Sky and weather proposals may target known-safe scalar fields in visualsettings.dat and timecycle/weather XML while preserving unknown fields and structure.
Hit Effect is the user-facing label; ptfx_blood_spray is the primary technical target unless live inspection proves it missing.
Smoke, fire, and resource-heavy particle visuals must be blanked with same-dimension and same-format replacement data; entries must not be deleted.
minimap.gfx editing uses JPEXS as an external SWF XML roundtrip tool; direct swf.xml editing remains available when JPEXS is absent.
JPEXS command-line automation can export and import SWF content; Redux Maker must validate a re-export before claiming persisted minimap edits.
The local classifier uses a small English sentence embedding model plus a Redux-specific ONNX head; template-split and independent-holdout accuracy must be reported separately.
The planner uses a compact GGUF model through llama.cpp and must return strict validated JSON before any task is routed.
The image worker downloads an Apache-2.0 diffusion model from its upstream registry and must produce engine-validated exact-size texture candidates.
Vision validation checks prompt and reference consistency separately from deterministic engine checks for dimensions, format, mip layout, and staged-file integrity.
Requests to delete particle records or patch original update.rpf in place must be rejected or converted to safe staged alternatives requiring approval.
